rows.en:
(Ahhh~, I'm starving~
What should I have for lunch today...?)

Ooh, just the person I needed!
\p, spotted!
Hm? Do you need something from me?
rows.notes: Shared with scd_com_626 (male player); works there too.

rows.en:
Well, for once I actually made some sandwiches,
but I got a little carried away
and made way too many.

I'd really appreciate it if you'd
help me eat them...

You cooking, Hoshimura? That's rare.
I'd love to have some.

That's my \p!
Go on, eat up, eat up.

Thanks for the food.
...Hm? What's in this sandwich?
Why is it all sparkly?
Oh, that one? It's Starlight Natto!
...Huh?

And this one's a sandwich born of a genius idea:
a maguro bun sandwiched in bread...
and this one is...

Sorry, Hoshimura.
I just remembered I've got something to do...
Even so, at least eat one before you go!
See ya, Hoshimura!

(Starlight Natto, seriously...
That's not something you put in a sandwich,
Hoshimura...)

(Ahhh~, I'm starving~
What should I have for lunch today...?)
Hm? Do you need something from me?
rows.notes: Shared with scd_com_626 (female player); works there too.

rows.en:
You cooking, Yui? That's rare.
I'd love to have some.

Thanks for the food.
...Hm? What's in this sandwich?
Why is it all sparkly?

Sorry, Yui.
I just remembered I've got something to do...
See you, Yui!

(Starlight Natto, seriously...
That's not something you put in a sandwich,
Yui...)

(Hm? There's noise coming from the Pilot Course
storeroom... Is somebody in there?)

This goes like this, so
that goes like that...
(Oh, it's just Hoshimura.)
What are you doing, Hoshimura?
Then I do this here...
Hellooo? Hoshimura-saaan?
rows.notes: The player teasingly adds -san (Hoshimura-saan) to the usual bare surname; kept.

rows.en: (She's totally oblivious to everything around her...)
Well, you look busy, so see you later.

Alriiight~! Done~!!
For Yui-san, a job like this is
as easy as a twiddly-tweak!
rows.notes: Chochoi no choi: echoes 'twiddly-tweak' from frd_yui_001 (c14091).

rows.en:
So, what did you need,
\p?
Wait, huh? Nobody's here......?

(Hm? There's noise coming from the Pilot Course
storeroom... Is somebody in there?)
(Oh, it's just Yui.)
What are you doing, Yui?
Hellooo? Yui-saaan?
(She's totally oblivious to everything around her...)
Well, you look busy, so see you later.
(Next class is pool. I'd better hurry up and get ready.)

Alriiight~!! It's pool time~!
I'm gonna swim till I drop~!!
...Hoshimura, you're getting way too worked up.

But I've been looking forward to it so much!
I couldn't wait, so I've already got
my swimsuit on under my clothes!
(It's not like she's in elementary school...)
rows.notes: Shared by both genders. Shotou-ka = the elementary division; 'elementary schooler' as in c07888/c17211.

rows.en:
That reminds me, back in elementary school
there was a kid who wore their swimsuit under
their clothes like you and forgot their underwear.
rows.notes: The forgetful classmate is unidentified (yatsu / ko): kept gender-neutral with singular 'they'.

rows.en: Hahaha! Somebody was really that dumb?
Yeah, there was. Pretty funny, huh?
Forgetting your underwear......
That's... not... so funny......

Hm?
Why are you glaring at your bag like that, Hoshimura?

N-No, it's nothing, really!
Seriously, nothing at all! No problemo!

Hey... Hoshimura......
Don't tell me......

Oh, silly me, I just remembered
I've got something to do! See ya!!
(Hoshimura... No way... Right......?)
(Next class is pool. I'd better hurry up and get ready.)
...Yui, you're getting way too worked up.

That reminds me, back in elementary school
there was a kid who wore their swimsuit under
their clothes like you and forgot their underwear.
Yeah, there was. Pretty funny, huh?

Hm?
Why are you glaring at your bag like that, Yui?

Hey... Yui......
Don't tell me......
(Yui... No way... Right......?)

uncertain: c20257/c20269: the elementary-school classmate who forgot their underwear is unidentified; kept neutral with singular 'they'.
